lines.en: label beachwars12:
scene poetrywinner1
: Miscreants, if I could please have your attention for a moment, I would now like to make an announcement in regard to Kumon-mi High’s first ever poetry contest.
lines.zh: : 恶徒们,能否请你们注意一下:我现在要宣布一件事,关于 Kumon-mi High 有史以来第一届诗歌比赛。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner2
: But before that, I’d like to give another “Fuck you” to your teacher, who has completely disregarded the sanctity of truth or dare by refusing to submit an entry for it.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前,我想再对你们的老师说一句『操你的』——他拒绝提交参赛作品,彻底无视了真心话大冒险的神圣性。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Sounds like Sensei’s joining Nodoka on the ban list.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。听起来 Sensei 要和 Nodoka 一起上黑名单了。

lines.en: : Oh? Perhaps {i}that{/i} is where I get my controversiality from. It was never my fault.
lines.zh: : 哦?也许我的争议性就是从{i}那儿{/i}来的。这从来都不是我的错。

lines.en: : Nodoka, you...do know Sensei isn’t your actual dad...right?
lines.zh: : Nodoka,你……知道 Sensei 不是你亲生父亲……对吧?

lines.en: : You can never be too sure.
lines.zh: : 这种事再怎么确定都不为过。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe. Question.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师。有个问题。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner3
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : If Sensei wasn’t so against doing anything fun or challenging and actually {i}did{/i} submit something for the contest, would he actually have been considered? I thought this was a thing for the students.
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 不是那么反对任何有趣或有挑战性的事、真的{i}提交{/i}了作品,他会真的被考虑吗?我以为这是给学生办的。

lines.en: : Age is not a viable factor when it comes to poetry as feelings shall not be gatekept by those who have lived longer.
lines.zh: : 在诗歌这件事上,年龄不是一个有效的因素,因为情感不该被活得更久的人把关。

lines.en: : And let me make myself {i}very clear{/i} in saying that is the {i}only{/i} area in which age is not a factor, {i}Arakawa.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而我要说得{i}非常清楚{/i}:这是年龄不作为因素的{i}唯一{/i}领域,{i}Arakawa{/i}。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe, there are two Arakawas here.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师,这里有两个 Arakawa。

lines.en: : Three if you count me.
lines.zh: : 算上我的话是三个。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner4
: I’m open to accepting you as a sister, Nodoka. But only because I know you’d be okay with me loving anyone I want.
lines.zh: : 我愿意接受你当妹妹,Nodoka。但这只是因为我知道,你会支持我去爱我任何想爱的人。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t just accept it. I would {i}encourage{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我不会只是接受。我会{i}鼓励{/i}。

lines.en: : Isn’t it a little too early for fringe fetishes? Or making Nodoka think her stances in regard to literally anything are, at bare minimum, somewhat normal?
lines.zh: : 现在谈边缘癖好是不是太早了点?或者让 Nodoka 以为她对任何事情的看法至少……还算正常?

lines.en: : If I am allowed to weigh in, yes. It is far too early for either of those things.
lines.zh: : 如果允许我发表意见的话,是的。这两件事都太早了。

lines.en: : They just don’t understand us.
lines.zh: : 她们就是不懂我们。

lines.en: : And they never will. Such is the burden of being special.
lines.zh: : 而且她们永远不会懂。这就是与众不同的负担。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner5
: I was obviously referring to Arakawa-prime. But I suppose that, for {i}everyone{/i} in this dysfunctional class’s sake, I should reiterate that your teacher is far too old for {i}any{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 我显然指的是正版 Arakawa。不过我想,为了这个不正常的班级里{i}所有人{/i}的缘故,我该重申一遍:你们的老师对你们{i}任何人{/i}来说都太老了。

lines.en: : I’m the oldest. Is-
lines.zh: : 我年纪最大。我可不可以——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner6
: Yes. If you haven’t graduated college yet, you’re too young to date your teacher.
lines.zh: : 不行。如果你还没大学毕业,那你太小了,不能跟你的老师交往。

lines.en: : Hmm...Perhaps I should take Toudai up on their offer after all?
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许我终究该接受 Toudai 的邀请?

lines.en: : I no longer accept you as a sister. Please leave.
lines.zh: : 我不认你当妹妹了。请离开。

lines.en: : At the risk of having her swarmed by the lot of you like the bees you are, I will hereby openly state that the {i}only{/i} one here I’d accept as a match for Arakawa would be his loyal, exuberant companion, Imani Imai.
lines.zh: : 冒着她被你们这群蜜蜂围住的风险,我在此公开声明:这里{i}唯一{/i}一个我认为配得上 Arakawa 的,是他忠诚而热情的伴侣,Imani Imai。

lines.en: : Get her, girls!
lines.zh: : 上啊,姑娘们!

lines.en: : Two things! Thing one — great wingman skills. Thing two — are you {i}also{/i} going to be providing the eulogy at my funeral?
lines.zh: : 两件事!第一——你这僚机当得真棒。第二——我葬礼上的悼词你{i}也{/i}要念吗?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner7
: Absolutely not. But, as I do not want to delay any further, perhaps you could get the winner of today’s contest to do it.
lines.zh: : 绝对不念。不过,既然我不想再拖下去了,也许你可以让今天比赛的获胜者来念。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner8
: Now, there were a total of only fifteen entries submitted. And more than half of them came from {i}this{/i} class as mine seems to be afraid of me for some reason.
lines.zh: : 这次一共只收到了十五份投稿。其中一半以上来自{i}这个{/i}班,而我带的班似乎出于某种原因很怕我。

lines.en: : Wow. I wonder why.
lines.zh: : 哇。我想知道为什么。

lines.en: : Shut up, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,Arakawa。

lines.en: : I wonder if Miss Watabe endorses herself as a match for Sensei too. I’m not alone in sensing the tension here, am I?
lines.zh: : 我在想 Watabe 老师是不是也把自己当成 Sensei 的般配对象。不止我一个人感觉到这里的紧张气氛吧?

lines.en: : Maybe I should add her to the ranking as well?
lines.zh: : 也许我该把她也加进排行榜?

lines.en: : Ushibori, you shut up as well. In fact, all of you shut up until I read the results of the contest and am free to go back to sleep in my room.
lines.zh: : Ushibori,你也闭嘴。事实上,你们全都闭嘴,等我把比赛结果念完,好自由地回房间睡觉。

lines.en: : And by {i}back{/i} I mean for the first time because, again, fuck you, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 而我说的{i}『回』{/i}是指『第一次去』,因为再说一次,操你的,Arakawa。

lines.en: : The fuck did you do to the goth teacher to get her to hate you this much?
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底对那个哥特老师做了什么,让她这么恨你?

lines.en: : Don’t actually answer that. The possibilities are endless and I’ll just pick the one I think fits the best.
lines.zh: : 别真的回答。可能性太多了,我会自己挑一个我觉得最合适的。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to read the results of the contest yet or are the lot of you going to keep serving as a barricade between my bed and me?
lines.zh: : 我可以念比赛结果了吗,还是你们这群人打算继续当我和我的床之间的路障?

lines.en: : Go ahead, Wakana. I apologize on behalf of my unruly class.
lines.zh: : 念吧,Wakana。我替我这个不守规矩的班向你道歉。

lines.en: : Fuck you again, Arakawa. You disrespected me and I will never forgive you for it.
lines.zh: : 再操你一次,Arakawa。你侮辱了我,我永远不会原谅你。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe seems to be fucking you a lot today. She’s bound to get tired soon.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师今天好像『操』了你很多次。她迟早会累的。

lines.en: : I hate every last one of you.
lines.zh: : 我恨你们每一个。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner9
: Just tell us the winner! And also, tell us what the winner wins! Cause I don’t remember seeing that on the form thingy!
lines.zh: : 快告诉我们冠军是谁!还有,告诉我们冠军赢什么!因为我不记得在那张表格上看到过!

lines.en: : It was there. You just probably haven’t learned to {i}read{/i} yet on account of your useless instructor.
lines.zh: : 上面写着呢。你大概只是还没学会{i}识字{/i},毕竟你的老师是个废物。

lines.en: : The winner of this year’s poetry contest will receive extra credit toward their lit grade this semester, as well as a 10,000 yen IC card for use...well, wherever IC cards are accepted.
lines.zh: : 今年诗歌比赛的冠军,将获得本学期文学成绩的额外学分,以及一张 1 万日元的 IC 卡,可用于……嗯,任何接受 IC 卡的地方。

lines.en: : I need both of those things.
lines.zh: : 这两样我都缺。

lines.en: : Well, that’s fantastic for you as the winner of this year’s contest is Yumi Yamaguchi for her poem, “I Fucking Hate the Summer.”
lines.zh: : 那对你来说太棒了,因为今年比赛的冠军是 Yumi Yamaguchi,她的诗作《我他妈恨死夏天了》。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner10
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: : Yumi?! {i}That{/i} Yumi?! The one currently guarding this year’s Dorm War prize?!
lines.zh: : Yumi?!{i}那个{/i} Yumi?!现在正在看守今年宿舍战争奖品的那个?!

lines.en: : I...didn’t even know...Yumi wrote poetry...
lines.zh: : 我……都不知道……Yumi 会写诗……

lines.en: : Neither did I...especially poetry good enough to win Wakana’s contest.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……尤其是好到能赢下 Wakana 比赛的诗。

lines.en: : I thought it was homework. I didn’t realize it was an optional thing. But fuck yeah, free IC card.
lines.zh: : 我以为那是作业。我不知道是可选项。不过操他妈的,免费的 IC 卡。

lines.en: : It is at this time that I would like to invite Yumi to read her poem for the class.
lines.zh: : 现在,我想请 Yumi 为全班朗读她的诗。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner11
: Uhh...do I, like...{i}have{/i} to?
lines.zh: : 呃……我、那个……{i}非读不可{/i}吗?

lines.en: : If you want your prize, yes. Otherwise, I am going to toss this notebook into the ocean and return to the inn, where I will proceed to pass out until tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 想要奖品的话,是的。否则,我就把这本笔记本扔进海里,回旅馆,然后一路睡到明天早上。

lines.en: : Fuckin’...ugh. Fine. I’ll read my stupid fucking poem.
lines.zh: : 他妈的……唉。行。我读我那首该死的蠢诗。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner12
: Well, that sucks. I thought I had a chance.
lines.zh: : 唉,真烂。我还以为我有机会呢。

lines.en: : Perhaps the rest of us have just been taking her intellect and creativity for granted?
lines.zh: : 也许我们其他人只是一直把她的才智和创造力当成理所当然了?

lines.en: : Yeah. Sometimes, artists can surprise you like that. Good for her.
lines.zh: : 是啊。有时候,艺术家就是能给你这样的惊喜。她挺好。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. No fuckin’ clue how this managed to win, but...I guess I’ve gotta read it now so I don’t go hungry and shit.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。这玩意儿到底是怎么赢的,我他妈完全没头绪,不过……我想我现在得把它读了,免得饿死之类的。

lines.en: : Uhh...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 呃……让我看看……

lines.en: : Roses are red...summer sucks balls-
lines.zh: : 玫瑰是红的……夏天烂透了——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner13
: NOW!
lines.zh: : 就是现在!

lines.en: : Huh? Now wha-
lines.zh: : 哈?现在什么——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner14
: On it!
lines.zh: : 收到!

lines.en: : Crap! Trash in the trash can! She blended right in!
lines.zh: : 靠!垃圾进垃圾桶!她伪装得一模一样!

lines.en: : We’ve been set up! Yumi! To your post!
lines.zh: : 我们被摆了一道!Yumi!回你的岗位!

lines.en: : What are you- mmphphfhfhf!?!
lines.zh: : 你们在干——唔呜呜呜?!?

lines.en: : Don’t worry about this one! I have her taken care of!
lines.zh: : 这个不用管!我搞定她了!

lines.en: scene poetrywinner15
: Maya! You don’t have to hug Sensei! Just prevent Noriko from doing it!
lines.zh: : Maya!你不用抱 Sensei!只要阻止 Noriko 去抱就行!

lines.en: : Right! Let’s-
lines.zh: : 明白!我们——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner16
: Fuck! {i}They’re{/i} in on it too!
lines.zh: : 操!{i}她们{/i}也是一伙的!

lines.en: : You bastards!
lines.zh: : 你们这些混蛋!

lines.en: scene poetrywinner17
: Sorry, guys. No hard feelings?
lines.zh: : 抱歉各位。别往心里去?

lines.en: : Just what is going on with this sand?!
lines.zh: : 这沙子到底怎么回事?!

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}And so arrives the end of an era. Parting is such sweet sorrow.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}一个时代就此终结。离别竟是如此甜蜜的忧伤。

lines.en: : Until we meet again, my dearest Lenore...
lines.zh: : 直到我们再次相见,我最亲爱的 Lenore……

lines.en: : Why are {i}you{/i} the one who’s upset?! You’re about to win!
lines.zh: : 为什么难过的是{i}你{/i}?!你马上就要赢了啊!

lines.en: : Pfhfphpt. Blechh. Fucking...sand in my mouth.
lines.zh: : 呸呸。呸。他妈的……一嘴沙子。

lines.en: : Nodoka promised to stop bothering Wakana in exchange for her cooperation here. You guys have been had.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 答应不再骚扰 Wakana,换取她在这里配合。你们被人耍了。

lines.en: : Or so you thought!
lines.zh: : 至少你是这么想的!

lines.en: scene poetrywinner18
: Rin?! Where did you come from?!
lines.zh: : Rin?!你从哪儿冒出来的?!

lines.en: scene poetrywinner19
: {i}Somewhere else!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别的地方!{/i}

lines.en: : Why would you say that like it’s so profound?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛说得这么深沉?!

lines.en: : Tch. You guys keep showing up at the very last second...
lines.zh: : 啧。你们每次都在最后一秒冒出来……

lines.en: : If you want to get to Sensei, you’re going to have to go through me first! And that’s a bad idea, Noriko! I’ve been listening to so much pop punk lately that {i}all{/i} I can think of is standing up for my friends!
lines.zh: : 想靠近 Sensei,你得先过我这关!而这可是个坏主意,Noriko!我最近听了太多流行朋克,{i}满脑子{/i}只想着为朋友挺身而出!

lines.en: : Like...the good kind? Or Blink 182?
lines.zh: : 是……好的那种?还是 Blink 182?

lines.en: : That’s going to offend someone! But the good kind!
lines.zh: : 这话会得罪人的!是好的那种!

lines.en: : Shit...
: Otoha! I’m sorry in advance!
lines.zh: : Otoha!我先说声抱歉!

lines.en: : Huh? Sorry for-
lines.zh: : 哈?抱歉什么——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner20
: There’s just no other way...
lines.zh: : 没有别的办法了……

lines.en: : Oh. {i}That’s{/i} why.
lines.zh: : 哦。{i}原来如此{/i}。

lines.en: : W...What do you think you’re doing?
lines.zh: : 你……你以为你在干什么?

lines.en: : Choosing {i}my friends over you...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}选择我的朋友,而不是你……{/i}

lines.en: : Noriko. Think about this for a second. If you show me, you’ll be showing Sensei too and-
lines.zh: : Noriko。你想一下。如果你给我看,那 Sensei 也会看到,而且——

lines.en: scene poetrywinner21
: Ta-dah.
lines.zh: : 当当。

lines.en: : Nice.
lines.zh: : 漂亮。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, team.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了,队友。

lines.en: : But this is where I fall.
lines.zh: : 但我就倒在这里了。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner22
: Always know your opponent’s weakness.
lines.zh: : 永远要了解对手的弱点。

lines.en: : Ooh. That one looked like it hurt.
lines.zh: : 噢。那一下看起来挺疼。

lines.en: : Noriko, I think you killed Rin.
lines.zh: : Noriko,我觉得你把 Rin 弄死了。

lines.en: : It’s what needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 这是必须做的事。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner23
: Now, prepare to be loved!
lines.zh: : 现在,准备好被爱吧!

lines.en: : Just get it over with already.
lines.zh: : 赶紧弄完吧。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner24
$ beachwarfloor2points += 2
: Hyaaaaaah!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊啊啊!

lines.en: : WOOOOOO! TWO POINTS FOR THE SECOND FLOOR! AND ALL IT TOOK WAS A LITTLE INDECENT EXPOSURE!
lines.zh: : 呜哦哦哦哦!二楼得两分!而代价只是一点点有伤风化的暴露!

lines.en: : Indecent exposure?! What the heck happened while I was trying to get Otoha’s foot off of my back?!
lines.zh: : 有伤风化?!我正努力把 Otoha 的脚从我背上弄下来的时候,到底发生了什么?!

lines.en: : What happened was we lost. But at least now I don’t have to be around Noriko anymore.
lines.zh: : 发生的是:我们输了。不过至少现在我不用再待在 Noriko 身边了。

lines.en: : Be more mad! She stole Sensei from you!
lines.zh: : 再气一点啊!她把 Sensei 从你身边抢走了!

lines.en: : I simply see it as her showcasing how beguiling and malicious she is beneath the brightly colored and visually unappealing shell.
lines.zh: : 我只是把这看作她在展示:在那层色彩鲜艳、视觉上毫无吸引力的外壳之下,她是多么迷人又恶毒。

lines.en: : How long are you going to hold this for, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你打算抱多久,Noriko?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner25
: Until you hug me back at least.
lines.zh: : 至少抱到你回抱我为止。

lines.en: : In front of everyone else? Are you {i}trying{/i} to get us killed?
lines.zh: : 当着所有人的面?你是{i}想{/i}害死我们吗?

lines.en: : To die by your side...is such a heavenly way to die.
lines.zh: : 能死在你身边……是何等神圣的死法。

lines.en: : Is that, like...a quote?
lines.zh: : 那个,是……一句歌词?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner26
: You don’t know the Smiths?! They’re on Nodoka’s shirt and everything! Come to my room next weekend and we can binge their discography together and make out.
lines.zh: : 你居然不知道 The Smiths?!Nodoka 的 T 恤上还印着他们呢!下周末来我房间,我们可以一口气刷完他们的全部专辑,然后接吻。

lines.en: : Okay, I think you should let me go now.
lines.zh: : 好了,我觉得你现在可以放开我了。

lines.en: scene black
scene poetrywinner27
: Well, now that that’s over and Arakawa has been assaulted, I suppose it’s time for me to read out the {i}actual{/i} winner of the contest.
lines.zh: : 嗯,既然这事结束了、Arakawa 也被袭击了,我想是时候由我来宣布比赛的{i}真正{/i}冠军了。

lines.en: : This ain’t fair! I was set-up!
lines.zh: : 这不公平!我被摆了一道!

lines.en: : We were {i}all{/i} set up, Yumi. It wasn’t just you.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}全都{/i}被摆了一道,Yumi。不只是你。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s {i}me{/i} who’s missin’ out on 10,000 yen now! People keep promisin’ me money just to rip it away! I’m callin’ bullshit!
lines.zh: : 是啊,可现在是{i}我{/i}少了 1 万日元!大家一直给我承诺钱,然后又把它抢走!我他妈不服!

lines.en: scene poetrywinner28
: How about I give you 10,000 yen of my own money just to get you to stop talking?
lines.zh: : 那我自己给你 1 万日元,只求你别再说了,怎么样?

lines.en: : Aight, deal. I ain’t mad anymore. Noodle Girl’s made herself an enemy though by puttin’ her hands on me again.
lines.zh: : 行,成交。我不生气了。不过面条妹又把手放到我身上,算是给自己树了个敌人。

lines.en: : In the words of the Emerald Guardian when she purposely stands in fire to make her healing numbers bigger, “worth it.”
lines.zh: : 用那位翡翠守护者故意站在火里、好让治疗量数字更大的话说,『值了』。

lines.en: : Do I need to pay {i}all{/i} of you to be quiet? Because I will.
lines.zh: : 我需要给钱才能让你们{i}全部{/i}闭嘴吗?因为我愿意。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind a bribe or two.
lines.zh: : 我也乐意收点贿赂。

lines.en: : Shut up, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,Arakawa。

lines.en: : The winner is Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 冠军是 Arakawa。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner29
: I’m getting mixed signals right now, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我现在接收到的信号很混乱,Wakana。

lines.en: : Not you. The other Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 不是你。是另一个 Arakawa。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner30
: {i}Ami{/i} Arakawa is the winner of this year’s poetry competition. And she can pick up her card in the main office at school when we return on Monday. That is all.
lines.zh: : {i}Ami{/i} Arakawa 是今年诗歌比赛的冠军。她可以在我们周一回校后到教务处领取她的卡。就这样。

lines.en: : {i}Ami{/i} Arakawa?
lines.zh: : {i}Ami{/i} Arakawa?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner31
: Did I...
: Did I actually win?
lines.zh: : 我真的赢了吗?

lines.en: : God, my head...the sand here really {i}is{/i} hard.
lines.zh: : 天哪,我的头……这里的沙子真够{i}硬{/i}的。

lines.en: : Miss Watabe, is this another set-up?
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师,这也是一场摆局吗?

lines.en: : It is not. And I’ve been meaning to ask you, Ami- was there a certain poet who may have inspired the writing style you used for your entries?
lines.zh: : 不是。而且我一直想问你,Ami——有没有某位诗人,可能启发了你投稿时使用的写作风格?

lines.en: : Because they read remarkably similarly to an infamous poet from my youth known only by the moniker of “The Girl Who-” Arakawa, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 因为它们读起来与我年轻时一位臭名昭著的诗人惊人地相似,那位诗人只有一个别称,叫『那个……的女孩』——Arakawa,你要去哪儿?

lines.en: : Bathroom.
lines.zh: : 洗手间。

lines.en: : Tch. {i}Coward.{/i}
: All I did was read through some of the old stuff my mom left me and try to do what {i}she{/i} did. Was it actually good?
lines.zh: : 我只是把我妈留下的一些旧东西读了一遍,然后试着照{i}她{/i}的样子写。它真的写得好吗?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner32
: Your mother?
lines.zh: : 你母亲?

lines.en: : Yeah. She was always writing stuff like that when I was little.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我小时候,她一直在写那种东西。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner33
: I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Would you mind maybe letting me take a look at-
lines.zh: : 你介意让我看一——

lines.en: : Sorry, Miss Watabe, but...it’s one of the only things I have left of her, so I don’t really feel comfortable with anyone else seeing it yet.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Watabe 老师,不过……这是我仅剩的、属于她的东西之一,所以我还不太想让任何人看到。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}I thought submitting a second entry after messing up the first one would have increased my chances...but it looks like it still wasn’t enough.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我本来以为在第一篇搞砸之后补投一篇,能提高我的胜算……可看起来还是不够。

lines.en: : I suppose there’s always next year. But, then again, poetry’s not exactly a strong suit of mine to begin with.
lines.zh: : 大概还有明年吧。不过话说回来,诗歌本来就不算我的强项。

lines.en: : I wonder if the end result would have changed if you would have submitted something?
lines.zh: : 我在想,如果你投稿了,结果会不会不一样?

lines.en: : You really should have, Nodoka. Your poetry’s always been really interesting. I’m not sure why you don’t write more of it.
lines.zh: : 你真该投的,Nodoka。你的诗一直都很有意思。我不明白你为什么不多写点。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner34
: Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka?

lines.en: : Um...hello? Anyone in there?
lines.zh: : 呃……喂?有人在吗?

lines.en: : N...Nodoka?..
lines.zh: : N……Nodoka?..

lines.en: : How close are you to her?
lines.zh: : 你和她有多亲近?

lines.en: scene poetrywinner35
: To who? Ami? She’s a pretty good friend. We play D&D and have club together. But it’s mostly just mutual interests and stuff. I’m way closer to you and Rin.
lines.zh: : 和谁?Ami?她是个挺不错的朋友。我们一起玩 D&D,还一起参加社团。不过主要是共同兴趣之类的。我和你还有 Rin 亲近多了。

lines.en: : Is that so?...
lines.zh: : 是这样吗?……

lines.en: scene poetrywinner36
: Why...do you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么……这么问?

lines.en: : Are you interested in her all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你突然对她感兴趣了?

lines.en: : Very.
lines.zh: : 非常感兴趣。

lines.en: : I can-
lines.zh: : 我可以——

lines.en: : I’m going to go talk to her.
lines.zh: : 我要去跟她谈谈。

lines.en: scene poetrywinner37
: Or...you can go off on your own and do it yourself. That’s fine too.
lines.zh: : 或者……你也可以自己一个人去。那样也行。
